lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Heartline Protocol is intended for adults. You must be 18 or older to play.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Confirm you are 18+ to continue. SFW Mode ON — no adult scenes in Chapter 1.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Lumina Quay wears rain like jewelry. Neon leases flicker over wet glass.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The envelope in your hand is heavy: Atelier Tower — Handler Lease Transfer.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Tonight, the Tower calls you home.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: You're early. Or the Breach is early. Hard to tell with Quay weather.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Mira Solenne. Independent agent. Congrats, {Handler}. The Tower's yours on paper.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I'm staying. First Sync is downstairs. Try not to look impressed when I'm brilliant.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Stages burn Stamina. The Room burns Heart Energy — that's for talking, not punching storms.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Team desk is where we pretend we have a plan. Jobs pay coins while we sleep.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Tip: Tap Stages to deploy. Tap Room when you want conversation over combat.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Breach static in the lobby. Small one. Perfect for a first Sync.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Match gems that match me — Verdant, or Prism if you're lucky. Fill my gauge. When it hits full, fire my Burst.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I'll do the heroic part. You do the clever part.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Handler! I mean — {Handler}! Ivy Cross. Independent. Mostly.

lines.speaker: Juniper
lines.text: Juniper Tate. Door guard. Age twenty-one, licensed, insured.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: They're ours. Ivy, Juniper — lanes. {Handler} — trust them.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: I won't drop the beat. Juniper has the shield. I'll drop the enemies.

lines.speaker: Juniper
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Assign up to 2 agents per lane: Front takes more hits, hits harder. Back safer for heals. Mid balanced.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Put Juniper Front. Ivy Front or Mid. I'm Mid — I share the beat.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Cascades are the Grid saying yes. Chase them, but don't tunnel so hard you miss a Burst window.

lines.speaker: Juniper
lines.text: Front is loud. That's fine. Loud means they're hitting me, not you.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: Back-lane snipers are rude. Burst feels good when rude things fall down.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Vitals look… dramatic. I'm Wren Halcyon — Tidewell night shift, Tower moonlighter.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Nobody yet. That's the goal.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Then I'm early. Perfect. I'll take Back lane and the kettle.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Wren Halcyon joined the squad. Role: Support. Attunement: Verdant.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Door's unlocked. That's rare. Come in.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: This is the Room. Not a briefing. Just… us, and the window, and Quay pretending to sleep.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Talk (5 Heart Energy): +20 Affection XP. Dialogue changes with Aff Rank.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Talk first. Gifts later — I like Sunwell Tea. Not Corp pens.

lines.speaker: System
lines.text: Assist Aim highlights a valid ≥3 swap. Use it when the board looks rude.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Telegraphs mean the enemy is about to Burst. Don't panic — plan the swap.

lines.speaker: Juniper
lines.text: Lease Reclaimer construct on sensors. Corp-shaped. Rude-shaped.

lines.speaker: Ivy
lines.text: We clear this, Chapter One's ours.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Shields up, egos measured, tea after.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: {Handler} — full squad. Prism if it shows. Burst windows matter. I'm with you.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Lobby's quiet. That's us. That's you.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Chapter 1 complete. Atelier Tower holds — for tonight.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: There's more Grid under this city than one chapter can hold. But the lease feels real now.
